invariants: Keep approved dense emitter footprints and physical positions; never high-pass display texture
Use an actual silhouette, not a visible convex plate or dark collar
Native JS RGB is authoritative; fractional branches and retained LED writes are not silently repaired
Full-lit color flow can use one artwork; moving heads/fronts require distinct generated positions
Static effects stay static; one-shots end and can replay

effects.label: 纯色
effects.behavior: Native solid is STATIC. Do not add blinking, scrolling, background movement or a fake playback cycle.
effects.appearance: uniform full-strip illumination in one source-frame color

effects.label: 学习分段
effects.behavior: Use every captured native JavaScript RGB state on its fixed logical index. Existing full-lit segments can animate using one fixed artwork; local flashes change only their corresponding light zones.
effects.appearance: bounded study segment with a controlled envelope and contrasting zone

effects.label: 计划分段

effects.label: 单点追逐
effects.behavior: One bright head advances toward larger logical indices, wrapping once around the fixed mirrored S strips.
effects.appearance: one bright moving head with a short dim tail

effects.label: 流星
effects.behavior: One head enters the logical path, advances toward larger indices, leaves a one-sided trailing wake, then exits; dark entry/exit phases are intentional.
effects.appearance: one concentrated bright head followed by a fading directional tail

effects.label: 流星雨
effects.behavior: Two heads progress at different rates toward larger logical indices, with independent trailing shimmer and sparse blue-white sparks.
effects.appearance: several staggered bright heads with separate fading tails

effects.label: 火焰
effects.behavior: Heat ignites at logical indices 0..2, diffuses toward larger indices, and cools. Warm tongues and hot ridges change shape and position.
effects.appearance: warm irregular flicker with clustered hot spots and darker gaps

effects.label: 冰火
effects.behavior: The same heat propagation toward larger logical indices uses BLUE/CYAN ice-flame RGB only. No orange/red ice-versus-fire split: actual function is blue fire.
effects.appearance: continuous upper ice-cyan to violet transition to lower ember-orange progression

effects.label: 闪电
effects.behavior: Use every captured native JavaScript RGB state on its fixed logical index. Existing full-lit segments can animate using one fixed artwork; local flashes change only their corresponding light zones.
effects.appearance: sparse abrupt bright impulses along the outer paths

effects.label: 中心脉冲
effects.behavior: A thin bright front expands from logical center 19.5 toward BOTH ends. This is expansion, never a translating single dot.
effects.appearance: broad brightness pulse expanding from the center

effects.label: 中心扩散
effects.behavior: A single front expands from logical center toward both ends and then holds its terminal state; no invented return trip.
effects.appearance: symmetric wavefront expanding outward from the center

effects.label: 中心收缩
effects.behavior: Two endpoint fronts contract toward logical center and hold; do not reverse this motion into expansion.
effects.appearance: symmetric wavefront contracting toward the center

effects.label: 阻尼回弹
effects.behavior: Paired fronts return inward and make successively SMALLER source-defined rebounds. Unlike ordinary chase this effect really changes direction.
effects.appearance: bright wave crest rebounding with decreasing amplitude

effects.label: 藤蔓伸展
effects.behavior: Two strands grow outward from logical center, leaving dim retained filaments. Preserve already illuminated strands behind their leading tips.
effects.appearance: thin organic tendril growing and bending along the path

effects.label: 气泡漂移
effects.behavior: Several drifting highlights advance at different speeds. The native function retains previously written LED values; preserve the actual accumulating occupancy.
effects.appearance: several rounded luminous bubbles moving along the path

effects.label: 呼吸渐变
effects.behavior: One global breathing intensity on all LEDs; fixed spatial distribution, no chase and no whole-drone dimming.
effects.appearance: whole pattern breathing smoothly between dim and bright

effects.label: 淡入淡出
effects.behavior: One-shot fade IN during 90 source frames, then hold; no invented fade-out half-cycle.
effects.appearance: smooth directional bright-to-dark fade

effects.label: 定向拖尾
effects.behavior: A head advances toward larger logical indices, with a dim one-sided trailing wake and periodic wrap.
effects.appearance: directional head with a tapered trail

effects.label: 定向擦除
effects.behavior: An illuminated area grows from logical index 0 toward 39 and holds; the cleared area shrinks in that direction.
effects.appearance: sharp directional boundary wiping across the strip

effects.label: 定向藤蔓
effects.behavior: A center-origin strand extends toward both ends, retaining dim light behind the moving front.
effects.appearance: single directional tendril with elongated organic trail

effects.label: 多点追逐
